body.message:
Hello Shawin,

Thank you for your patience.

We have received confirmation from our manager that we are unable to make any changes to the contract, and it will remain as issued.

Additionally, it is not possible to contact the owner directly, as we are the authorized company managing the property on the owner's behalf.

Please let us know if you would still like to proceed with the booking. We will be happy to assist you.

Thank you.
